adrs.ADR-0062: Accepted 2026-06-30 (b07e887) — Agent-initiated Runs: operator-issued delegation grants as the agent's bounded standing authority. Grant = revocable server-side record (agent never mints; RFC 7662 custody); launch via the run.launch gateway tool + a subject-pinned (mcp-gateway) forward to api (the symmetric-key holder stays non-agent-reachable — SEC-20 preserved); actor/principal split (RFC 8693) with policy-subject = agent (flagged steps still park); plan-vs-grant in api (the relocated SEC-16); instant cascading revocation; agent-tool → agent-remote-session bracket with recorded principal/grant. Extends ADR-0061 + ADR-0046; preserves ADR-0060; edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).
